card.statement: Let $\lambda,\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ with $\lambda$ dominant. Then $\dim\mathsf{F}_{\mu}({\mathbf{IC}}_{\lambda})$ is the number of irreducible components of $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\cap S_{\mu}$. In particular, it is nonzero if and only if $\mu\in\mathop{\mathrm{Conv}}(W\lambda)\cap\bigl(\lambda+Q^{\vee}\bigr)$.
card.label: Proposition 5.13

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
